description: Land Acquisition - Kandegedara, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District and Beligamuwa, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including their locations, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses on the legal process of taking possession of land for public purposes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the land acquisition process and does not involve government structural changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
